title: The Valley of the Centaurs
content:
Having traveled through the mountains for three days, Lucas and his sister, Elena, were exhausted. They had been searching for an ancient valley that, according to an old map, was hidden somewhere beyond the northern cliffs.

Having lost their original path that morning, they decided to follow a narrow trail between the trees.

— Are you sure this is the right way? — Elena asked.

— I don't know, but the map says we should find a river before sunset.

After walking for another hour, they heard the sound of running water. They quickly followed the noise and discovered a wide river surrounded by enormous trees.

However, they also noticed something unusual.

Large footprints had been left in the wet soil. They looked like the footprints of horses, but they were much larger.

— These tracks are strange — Elena said.

Lucas knelt down to examine them.

— Having seen footprints like these in old drawings, I think I know what made them.

Before Elena could answer, a deep voice came from behind them.

— You should not be here.

They turned around and froze.

Standing between the trees was a centaur. He had the body of a powerful horse and the upper body of a man. He was carrying a bow and watching them carefully.

Elena slowly raised her hands.

— We don't want to cause any trouble.

The centaur lowered his bow slightly.

— Humans rarely come to this valley without looking for something.

Lucas showed him the old map.

— We are looking for the ancient valley marked here.

The centaur studied the map.

— You have found it.

Having heard those words, Lucas smiled with relief.

— Can you take us there?

The centaur hesitated.

— Perhaps. But you must understand that the valley is dangerous.

Having spent many years protecting the region, the centaurs knew every path through the mountains. They also knew about creatures that lived beyond the river.

The centaur introduced himself as Arion and led the two humans through the forest.

After crossing the river, they entered a wide valley surrounded by enormous cliffs. Several centaurs were living there, along with horses and other animals.

Elena looked around in amazement.

— I've never seen anything like this.

Arion smiled.

— Most humans haven't.

Suddenly, a loud sound came from the mountains.

The centaurs immediately became alert.

— What was that? — Lucas asked.

Arion picked up his bow.

— A rockslide. Having heard that sound before, I know what is coming.

Everyone began moving toward the center of the valley.

A few seconds later, rocks started falling from the cliffs.

Having realized that Elena was standing too close to the mountain, Lucas ran toward her.

— Elena, move!

He grabbed her arm and pulled her away just before several large rocks crashed onto the ground.

When everything became quiet again, Arion looked at them.

— You were lucky.

Lucas looked at the fallen rocks.

— We couldn't have escaped without your help.

Arion shook his head.

— And we couldn't have warned everyone without you.

Having worked together, the humans and centaurs had protected the entire valley.

As the sun began to set, Arion showed Lucas and Elena the ancient ruins they had been searching for.

The journey had not been easy. Having crossed dangerous mountains, followed an unknown trail, and faced a sudden rockslide, they had finally reached their destination.

But they had discovered something even more valuable than the ruins.

They had discovered a world where humans and centaurs could become allies.
